nodes.label: Server-Timing latency diagnostics
nodes.description: Dashboard and identity responses expose auth, profile, membership and applicable query durations, retaining completed and failed stage durations. Parallel spans overlap; total excludes startup before the handler, browser network time and hydration.

nodes.label: Signed-in deployment performance verification
nodes.description: Deployment checks cover one-request bootstrap, 30-second cache reuse, write invalidation, payment network checks, cross-account isolation and first versus warm timing traces. Local tests alone do not establish production latency gains.

nodes.label: Repeated-request latency
nodes.description: Implemented changes reuse workspace context, authenticated identity and membership lookups; billing reads run in parallel and API routes handle their own cookie refresh. Local public garage timings do not establish signed-in endpoint latency.

nodes.label: Dashboard bootstrap
nodes.description: Successful dashboard entry makes one /api/dashboard request with identity and dashboard data, one session verification, profile read and membership read. The shell primes the cache before page mounting. Other direct dashboard visits use /api/me; dashboard failure preserves navigation.

nodes.label: Write and session cache invalidation
nodes.description: Successful writes, multipart uploads and payment reconciliation invalidate reads and cancel older requests. Sign-in/out clears caches and signals other tabs to reload sessions. Failed responses and payment checks are uncached; the existing garage booking PUT remains a read.

nodes.label: TanStack Query dashboard cache
nodes.description: src/lib/client-cache.ts holds successful reads in tab memory for 30 seconds, keyed by account, garage, role, method and URL. Private responses are neither server-render cached nor persisted in browser storage. HTTP responses remain private, no-store.

nodes.label: Screenshot of first name and last name fields
nodes.norm_label: screenshot of first name and last name fields

nodes.label: Account uniqueness requirements
nodes.description: Uniqueness should apply only to email, phone, business name and shop name. Passwords must not have global uniqueness. Duplicate records currently return 409 and a generic message with insufficiently clear blue highlighting.

nodes.label: Customer workspace flash for garage owners
nodes.description: Garage owners briefly see the customer color scheme and sidebar during loading.
nodes.norm_label: customer workspace flash for garage owners

nodes.label: Sensitive-field encryption and lookup hashes
nodes.description: Phone and VIN-style fields use AES-256-GCM encryption with separate one-way normalized hashes for exact lookups.
nodes.rationale: Separate hashes support exact matching without deterministic encryption.

nodes.label: Exact money arithmetic
nodes.description: Money uses PostgreSQL NUMERIC and Decimal.js.

nodes.label: Workshop workflow limits
nodes.description: No automatic notification delivery, individual mechanic shifts, cross-business staff switching, owner transfer, credit-note/refund workflow or native PDF renderer is introduced.

nodes.label: Atomic repair status transitions
nodes.description: Status changes lock booking and job, validate stage, steps and staff, and save both statuses plus notification atomically. Same-status retries preserve timestamps and avoid duplicate notices while recovering missing effects. Unfinished steps cannot be added or restored after READY; completed-step notes remain editable until closure.

nodes.label: Workshop workflows migration
nodes.description: 20261102133752_workshop_workflows.sql adds quotes, parts movements, scheduling, invitations, sharing grants and reminders. Existing invoices are preserved; uninvoiced repairs require an approved itemized quote.

nodes.label: Paystack failed-payment reservation release
nodes.description: A server-verified failed transaction releases its reservation only after reference, amount, currency and payout destination match. It creates no invoice credit. Processing returns HTTP 202; resolved outcomes return HTTP 200 with status and paid. A terminal failure is not payment confirmation.

nodes.label: Workshop migration and rollout
nodes.description: Back up the target database, apply migrations in filename order including corrective access changes, configure environment, deploy, configure bays and staff, then exercise a complete customer/mechanic journey. This checkout lacks live credentials or a linked Supabase project.

nodes.label: Production hardening prerequisites
nodes.description: Before launch: backups and required PITR, server-only secret management, Auth redirects and templates, TLS, Daraja credentials and callback allowlists, rate limiting, observability, tenant isolation testing and a Kenya Data Protection Act impact assessment.

nodes.label: Booking and repair workflow
nodes.description: Customers request visits; authorized staff approve or decline, check in approved visits, create jobs, manage ordered steps, invoice, and complete collection.

nodes.label: Expired subscription read-only requirement
nodes.description: Expired trials and PAST_DUE garages should retain reads and lose writes through one shared helper. The report states that the current helper blocks only SUSPENDED and CANCELLED garages; no grace duration has been agreed.

nodes.label: Customer-controlled vehicle history projection
nodes.description: History exposes customer-facing fields only. Garage reads require an owner grant and active authorized membership, without internal notes or access to other garages' operational APIs. Signed photo links expire after five minutes.

nodes.label: Staff invitations
nodes.description: Invitations require a matching verified email, expire after seven days, may be revoked, and allow one active garage membership per account. Invitations appear in-app without automatic invitation emails.

nodes.label: Idempotent invoice creation
nodes.description: Invoice creation locks the job and returns an existing invoice on repeated requests.

nodes.label: Booking photos and garage logos
nodes.description: JPG, PNG and WebP booking photos use private Supabase Storage and short-lived authorized read URLs; garage logos use a separate public bucket.

nodes.label: Live payment prerequisites
nodes.description: Live collection requires verified per-garage merchant/payout accounts, Stripe Connect and suitable Daraja credentials, onboarding, refunds, reconciliation monitoring and operational handling of ambiguous outcomes. Substituting live secrets alone must not remove sandbox restrictions.

nodes.label: Unresolved payment outcome handling
nodes.description: M-Pesa timeouts before saving checkout IDs remain pending for operator verification. Older unresolved Stripe attempts require operator reconciliation. Pending, abandoned, unknown or unverified Paystack outcomes retain reservations; elapsed time alone does not release them.
nodes.rationale: Blindly repeating unresolved requests can charge twice, so uncertainty requires provider verification rather than automatic timeout cancellation.

nodes.label: AutoCare
nodes.description: Multi-tenant automotive service management for Kenyan drivers and garages using Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase Auth, Postgres and Storage, Paystack, and M-Pesa Daraja.

nodes.label: Next.js modular monolith
nodes.description: Next.js App Router handlers are transport adapters; domain services own authorization, transactions and business rules. Supabase Postgres is the system of record and the Supabase JavaScript SDK is the persistence adapter.

nodes.label: Platform, franchise and shop tenancy
nodes.description: Operational data is scoped by franchiseId and additionally shopId for branches. Customers and vehicles are platform-owned. Membership grants a franchise role and optional branch; null shopId means franchise-wide. Platform administrators receive no implicit workshop access.

nodes.label: Workshop capability matrix
nodes.description: Owner/admin, manager, advisor, mechanic, inventory clerk and accountant capabilities differ. Only owners invite or deactivate administrators; owners cannot be deactivated through staff management. Non-admin invitations need a branch. Customers alone decide quotes and control sharing and reminders.

nodes.label: Transactional parts movements
nodes.description: Parts movements lock job and inventory rows and use unique request IDs for retry safety.

nodes.label: Versioned quote approval
nodes.description: Quotes lock jobs and assign sequential versions. Customer decisions lock the same job and reject outdated versions.

nodes.label: Server-only database access boundary
nodes.description: RLS is enabled throughout. Operational tables, history consent, related tables and profile updates deny browser writes or access as appropriate. Corrective migrations 20261116000100 through 20261116000400 restore boundaries while preserving records. Vehicles retain owner-only CRUD, memberships self-only reads, and profiles self-only reads.

nodes.label: M-Pesa Express STK reconciliation
nodes.description: STK requests supply the callback URL automatically. A callback alone cannot settle an invoice: AutoCare queries Safaricom and matches the checkout ID. STK callbacks do not use C2B URL registration.

nodes.label: Branch and mechanic scheduling serialization
nodes.description: Scheduling serializes by branch and mechanic and checks overlapping appointments, including mechanics working across branches.

nodes.label: Paystack subscriptions and garage payouts
nodes.description: Starter costs KES 3,500 monthly after an optional 14-day trial. Checkout validates plan amount, currency and interval. Garage bank onboarding creates a subaccount with 0% platform share; account numbers are sent to Paystack without being stored by AutoCare.

nodes.label: Demo-garage sandbox payment boundary
nodes.description: Stripe Checkout and M-Pesa Express accept sandbox credentials only and are restricted to PAYMENT_TEST_FRANCHISE_ID. Tests update demo invoices and create is_test=true payments. Provider credentials belong in Vercel Secret variables.

nodes.label: Server identity and tenant authorization
nodes.description: Supabase Auth owns credentials and HTTP-only SSR sessions. Services treat client IDs as lookup hints and validate ownership, membership, branch relationships, subscription and roles before mutations. Service-role credentials remain server-only.

nodes.label: Documentation and repository drift
nodes.description: The report identifies security documentation misalignment and unused Docker files under Vercel deployment; legacy Prisma migrations are proposed for retention pending lead confirmation.

nodes.label: Reported inactive photo upload buttons
nodes.description: The report says photo upload buttons do nothing and speculates that Supabase object storage is unconfigured.

nodes.label: Stripe sandbox checkout reconciliation
nodes.description: The webhook handles checkout completion, asynchronous success and expiry, verifies the raw signature and retrieves the session before settlement. Cancel redirects preserve open checkout; confirmed expiry releases reservations. Initiation retries reuse an idempotency key up to 23 hours.

nodes.label: Authenticated workshop transaction flow
nodes.description: UI passes through authenticated Next.js routes, role/ownership validation, service-role clients and transaction RPCs. src/lib/permissions.ts supplies navigation/capability mapping. RPCs independently validate verified actors, membership, branches, assignment and approval; only service_role can invoke them.

nodes.label: Embedded PostgreSQL workshop verification
nodes.description: npm test applies all migrations and checks approvals, stock, returns, idempotency, shortages, totals, conflicts, invitations, mileage, grants and legacy handover. Separate tests cover history revocation and capabilities. Stubbed Auth/Storage schemas do not replace hosted relationship, real session, upload or browser acceptance checks.

nodes.label: Authenticated Supabase photo storage
nodes.description: repair-photos is private and garage-logos public. Uploads and signed photo reads pass authenticated tenant-checked server routes. The legacy generic upload route remains disabled.

nodes.label: Local and integration verification
nodes.description: typecheck, lint, test and build validate the application. npm test runs unit and embedded PostgreSQL tests offline. Integration tests require explicit local TEST_SUPABASE credentials, never load application credentials, and reject nonlocal hosts.

nodes.label: Next.js version-specific guidance
nodes.rationale: The installed Next.js version has breaking changes, so agents must consult node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code. next dev regenerates this guidance.

nodes.label: Greenfield migration decision
nodes.rationale: The supplied workspace had no earlier frontend, Flask backend, Git history, business types or tests to preserve, so implementation started greenfield without localStorage persistence. A recovered client should migrate domain by domain against the APIs.
